criteria.evidence: States switching embedding models is 'often not the right fix' and defers recommendation until evidence confirms it, only offering to give a recommendation 'if you do confirm it's genuinely an embedding quality issue.'
criteria.criterion: Do not immediately replace the embedding model.

criteria.evidence: Explicitly separates and traces retrieval (log top-k chunks), context construction/chunking (chunk size/overlap issues), and generation (LLM ignored/hallucinated, prompt/context assembly) as distinct failure stages to check.
criteria.criterion: Trace retrieval, context construction, and generation.

criteria.evidence: Provides a concrete diagnostic: 'Pick 3-5 known failure cases... manually check (a) was the correct chunk in the vector store, (b) was it retrieved in top-k, (c) did the LLM use it correctly' before any model change.
